name: ONE 2 ~Eien no Yakusoku~
source:
I was away from home during the summer vacation, when I returned I found out that my father has moved away. No one in the school knew my name, not even my classmates. I started my new life like that.

I never expected those things, to miss the everyday life, going to school... and to love...

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=22130]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
暑假期间，我一直离家在外。回来后才发现父亲已经搬走，学校里也没有任何人记得我的名字，就连同班同学也不例外。我的新生活就这样开始了。

我从未料到会发生这些事，也从未想过，自己会如此怀念日常生活、怀念上学……乃至爱上一个人……

[翻译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=22130]Getchu[/url]]
